ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black) comprise >95% of the visible fluke surface area; high-intensity pixels (white) are localized to discrete surface anomalies and the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-intensity pigmentation across the contiguous fluke surface, interrupted by discrete, high-contrast white circular blobs and ring-shaped point-features scattered non-uniformly.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle approximately 45 degrees with a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 25% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the upper boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys increases significantly toward the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, while the leading (bottom) edge displays a broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (approx. 30+ instances) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-oriented linear pixel disruptions (light intensity on dark background) visible on the medial-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, high-texture irregular anomalies (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive distribution of circular ring-voids in the primary dark pigmentation across both lobes, creating a 'punched' or 'stamped' visual texture.
